assets/advanced/topic_2_01.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An adaptable wild canid native to</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">North America, smaller and generally</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">more slender than a grey wolf.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Wildlife and feeding</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_02.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An animal that feeds on dead animal</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">material it has not itself killed.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Wildlife and feeding</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_03.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The decaying flesh of dead animals</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">that can serve as food for other</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">organisms.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Wildlife and feeding</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_04.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An interaction in which one organism</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">captures and consumes another as</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">prey.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Wildlife and feeding</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_05.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Originating or occurring naturally</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">in a region, rather than introduced</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">there by people.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Distribution and status</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_06.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Naturally restricted to a particular</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">geographic region or habitat.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Distribution and status</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_07.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Of an introduced organism that</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">spreads and causes ecological or</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">other harm in its new setting.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Distribution and status</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_08.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Living in the wild after descent</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">from, or escape from, a domesticated</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">population.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Distribution and status</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_09.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Active primarily around dawn and</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">dusk, rather than throughout</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">daylight or the entire night.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Behaviour and adaptation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_10.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Difficult to find, observe, capture</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">or clearly establish.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Behaviour and adaptation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_11.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Features that make an organism</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">harder to detect against its</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">surroundings.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Behaviour and adaptation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_12.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Resemblance to another organism or</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">signal that changes how a receiver</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">responds.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Behaviour and adaptation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_13.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A close association between</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">organisms of different species; in</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">broad usage, benefits need not be</text><text x="24" y="160" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">mutual.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Species interactions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_14.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An interaction between species in</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">which both participants benefit.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Species interactions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_15.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An interaction in which one species</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">benefits while the other is not</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">appreciably helped or harmed.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Species interactions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_16.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An association in which a parasite</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">benefits by exploiting a host that</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">is harmed.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Species interactions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_17.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Caused by human activity rather than</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">arising solely from non-human</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">natural processes.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Precise descriptions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_18.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Seriously harmful, often in a</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">gradual, subtle or difficult-to-</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">detect way.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Precise descriptions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_19.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Continuing in a way that cannot be</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">prevented, halted or persuaded to</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">change.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Precise descriptions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_20.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Insecure or unstable, with a</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">significant risk of failure, loss or</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">deterioration.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Precise descriptions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_21.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Gradual intrusion into territory,</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">habitat or space previously occupied</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">by something else.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Habitat pressures</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_22.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The division of a previously more</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">continuous habitat into smaller,</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">separated patches.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Habitat pressures</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_23.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A deterioration in the quality,</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">condition or ecological functioning</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">of an environment.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Habitat pressures</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_24.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A reduction in the quantity or stock</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">of an available resource.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Habitat pressures</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_25.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Nutrient enrichment of water that</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">can promote excessive growth and</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">subsequent oxygen depletion.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem processes</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_26.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The net build-up of a substance</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">within an organism as uptake exceeds</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">elimination over time.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem processes</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_27.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An increase in a substance's</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">concentration at successively higher</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">trophic levels through feeding.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem processes</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_28.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Indirect effects that propagate</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">across feeding levels after a change</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">in part of a food web.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem processes</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_29.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A species with an ecological effect</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">disproportionately large relative to</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">its abundance.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem structure</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_30.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The environmental requirements,</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">resource use and interactions that</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">define a species' ecological role.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem structure</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_31.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The population size an environment</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">can sustain under specified resource</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">and environmental conditions.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem structure</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_32.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A change in community composition</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">over time following disturbance or</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">the formation of new habitat.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem structure</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_33.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A North American wild canid adapts</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">to disconnected patches of urban</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">habitat.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Wildlife and feeding</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_34.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The animal consumes already-dead</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">organisms and helps return nutrients</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">to the ecosystem.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Wildlife and feeding</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_35.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Dead animal flesh becomes scarce,</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">changing the population's feeding</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">opportunities.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Wildlife and feeding</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_36.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The risk of being captured and eaten</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">changes prey behaviour before</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">numbers fall.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Wildlife and feeding</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_37.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The species occurs naturally in the</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">region but is not restricted to that</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">single location.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Distribution and status</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_38.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The species occurs naturally only</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">within one geographic area.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Distribution and status</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_39.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An introduced species spreads and</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">harms the existing ecosystem, rather</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">than merely being foreign.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Distribution and status</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_40.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Formerly domestic animals or their</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">descendants now live without human</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">care.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Distribution and status</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_41.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Activity is concentrated in the</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">twilight periods at either end of</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">the day.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Behaviour and adaptation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_42.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An organism proves difficult to</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">locate or observe reliably, despite</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">repeated searches.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Behaviour and adaptation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_43.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Blending into the background makes</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">an organism harder to notice.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Behaviour and adaptation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_44.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">An organism resembles another</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">organism or its signal to influence</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">a receiver's behaviour.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Behaviour and adaptation</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_45.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A broad category covers close</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">interspecies associations without</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">specifying who benefits.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Species interactions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_46.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Both species obtain a net benefit</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">from the interaction.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Species interactions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_47.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">One participant benefits while the</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">other experiences no appreciable</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">effect.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Species interactions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_48.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">One organism gains resources from a</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">host whose fitness is reduced.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Species interactions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_49.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A change is attributed to human</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">activity rather than exclusively to</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">natural variation.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Precise descriptions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_50.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Serious harm develops subtly and</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">becomes evident only over time.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Precise descriptions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_51.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A continuing trend cannot be halted</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">under the stated conditions.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Precise descriptions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_52.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Recent improvement is insecure and</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">could be reversed by one adverse</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">event.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Precise descriptions</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_53.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Development progressively occupies</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">space adjoining or belonging to an</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">existing habitat.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Habitat pressures</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_54.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A continuous habitat is split into</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">disconnected pieces that can isolate</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">populations.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Habitat pressures</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_55.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Habitat quality worsens even when</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">its total area remains unchanged.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Habitat pressures</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_56.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The amount of a resource falls as</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">withdrawals repeatedly exceed</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">replacement.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Habitat pressures</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_57.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Nutrient enrichment stimulates</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">growth whose decay can deprive</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">aquatic animals of oxygen.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem processes</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_58.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A substance builds up within the</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">same organism over time.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem processes</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_59.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Contaminant concentrations rise when</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">moving up successive feeding levels.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem processes</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_60.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A change at one feeding level</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">indirectly affects organisms at</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">other levels.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem processes</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_61.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">A relatively scarce species has an</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">outsized influence on the</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">surrounding community.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem structure</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_62.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Species share a place but differ in</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">how they use resources and interact</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">with their surroundings.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem structure</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_63.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">Environmental conditions reduce the</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">population size that can be</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">supported sustainably.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem structure</text></svg>
assets/advanced/topic_2_64.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 320"><rect x="1" y="1" width="398" height="318" rx="20" fill="#fffefa" stroke="#527658" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M20 1h360q19 0 19 20v25H1V21Q1 1 20 1" fill="#527658"/><text x="24" y="30" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="white">C2 · PRECISE MEANING</text><text x="24" y="85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">The composition of a community</text><text x="24" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">changes through successive stages</text><text x="24" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#243842">over time.</text><text x="24" y="299" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#527658">Ecosystem structure</text></svg>
